about_the_game:
Command your custom-built combat ship in large space battles.

Fight alone, bring up to 3 friends in co-op, or face other captains in competitive fleet combat.

Tactical Space Combat

Pilot powerful ships in fast paced top-down battles.

  • Command fighter squadrons, bombers, and support craft

  • Capture objectives and control the battlefield

  • Outmaneuver enemies through positioning and fleet tactics

  • Use different tactical approaches including:

    • Firepower

    • Utility

    • Defense

    • Disruption

    • Positioning

    • Team support

Every battle rewards smart decisions, teamwork, and adapting your strategy.

Customize Your Ship

Design the ship that fits your playstyle.

  • Equip different weapons, equipment, and internal systems

  • Choose from 36 ship types across 9 ship classes (more to come)

  • Customize paint schemes and cosmetics

  • Experiment with different builds to discover powerful strategies

Every captain brings a unique ship to battle.

1-4 Player Co-op Mode

Join forces with friends aboard the Cosmara and attempt to escape the system.

  • Play with 1-4 players in co-op

  • Progress through mission after mission

  • Upgrade your ships as the campaign unfolds

  • Fight AI fleets and complete objectives as a team

  • Assist human factions and earn their favor

  • Survive the pursuit of the endless autonomous fleet

Each run offers new challenges as you push deeper into the campaign.

Competitive Multiplayer

Test your skill against other captains.

  • Battle in team or solo matches

  • Capture objectives and control the battlefield

  • Adapt your ship builds during the match to counter enemies

  • Navigate dangerous terrain and environmental hazards

Victory is earned through coordination, smart builds, and tactical awareness.

Progress and Unlock

Build your reputation as a captain.

  • Earn experience and level up your account

  • Unlock unique callsigns

  • Earn currency to purchase cosmetics and paint schemes

  • Track your lifetime statistics on your player profile

Become the greatest captain in the universe. Save the Earth.

name: Cosmara

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 32-bit or 64-bit Microsoft Windows 10, 11, or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel 2.0 GHz (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB DirectX 9 Graphics Card or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 32-bit or 64-bit Microsoft Windows 10, 11, or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel 2.5 GHz (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB DirectX 11 Graphics Card or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: COSMARA is a unique blend between Tactical and Action gameplay. Create the perfect ship loadout for each mission and take to the void as you fight other player captains in PVP or take on the AI Armada in either solo or co-op.
